author: KEXP
description: San Francisco-born artist La Doña explores identity and environment with a breathtaking blend of reggaeton, Caribbean beats, and hip hop styles. Live on KEXP at Noise Pop, she shares a performance of "Tus Besos" and more.
title: La Doña performs "Tus Besos" & more Live on KEXP
